dispositions.topic_text: Completeness, uniqueness, and confirmed-action-to-owner-action mapping of CONFIRMED_OWNER_ACTIONS
Exact field names, types, and declaration order of ConfirmedOwnerAction
dispositions.what: State 6 declares ConfirmedOwnerAction's exact field names, types and order (now confirm_action: ConfirmedAction, then owner_action: OwnerAction, in 60_model_closure_values.json); every option keeps exactly the two facts, the confirmed action and the owner action.
keeps:
its two fields name the confirmed action
(M20, M31) and the owner action (M27)
options: Declare the same two typed fields in the reverse order.
Use other explicit field names with `ConfirmedAction` and `OwnerAction`, preserving exactly the two stated facts.
consequences: The chosen names determine generated member access and imports; the chosen order determines generic field walking and confirmation-input serialization, so every consumer must use the single State 6 declaration.
